statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitor study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The Holter monitor was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic episodes
The Holter monitor is medically necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm and guide appropriate management
The service was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
